Hi Olivia — quick technical notes from our side so NetOps has the specifics for the allowlist and peering.

API key & org setup
- Keys: two keys will be issued under the Mediva org. Scopes: "ingest:read" and "generate:write". Keys are rate-limited by default to protect the sandbox; we can raise limits for demo windows.
- Audit: all token issuances recorded in account audit logs; keys can be rotated via console or API.

IP allowlist and peering details (short)
- Redwood egress IPs for staging: 18.199.32.0/21, 3.210.12.0/22 (we'll provide a final CIDR list in the peering ticket).
- VPC peering: we support AWS VPC peering and RFC1918-based peering; exchange v4 CIDR and a single BGP ASN if you want dynamic routing. Typical approach: Mediva creates a peering request in your account, Redwood accepts and we confirm routes.

Support window
- We can do a technical 1-hour window for peering and firewall verification on Sep 6 (09:00–10:00 PT). Please let us know if that works.

If Mediva prefers static allowlisting instead of peering, we can still proceed — the MAP just needs to call that out and pick a target activation date.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
